speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Minister for National Development whether motorists can be allowed to use the old parking coupons at pro-rated rates.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: HDB and URA have been actively monitoring the sale and exchange of coupons.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I would also like to ask a second supplementary question: in future, whether there can be the option of allowing the old supply of coupons to be used up in the market and simply replaced?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: This means, old coupons will not be issued anymore and new coupons being issued, rather than requiring motorists to actually go into petrol stations and convenience stores and so on, to do an exchange, because that creates hassle for the motorists and also creates an administrative burden.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Many people have already changed and exchanged their coupons.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: During this transition period, we have issued advisories, rather than offence notices.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: So, it is better to operationally cart over to the new parking coupons.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The Member's other point is for the future.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: So, his suggestion about, if in future, there needs to be any change, that old coupons should be allowed to be used, we hope technology will replace all of that.
